# Release Notes Template

When creating a new release, copy this template and fill in the details.

---

## 🎉 What's New in v0.x.x

### ✨ Features
- **Feature Name**: Brief description of the new feature
- **Another Feature**: What it does and why it's useful

### 🐛 Bug Fixes
- Fixed issue where [describe the problem]
- Resolved [specific bug description]

### 🔧 Improvements
- Improved performance of [component/feature]
- Enhanced UI/UX for [specific area]

### 📦 Downloads

Choose the installer for your platform:

| Platform | File | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| 🍎 macOS (Apple Silicon) | `LoreNote_*_aarch64.dmg` | For M1/M2/M3 Macs |
| 🍎 macOS (Intel) | `LoreNote_*_x64.dmg` | For Intel Macs |
| 🐧 Linux (Debian/Ubuntu) | `lore-note_*_amd64.deb` | .deb package |
| 🐧 Linux (Universal) | `lore-note_*_amd64.AppImage` | Portable AppImage |
| 🪟 Windows | `LoreNote_*_x64-setup.exe` | Installer |
| 🪟 Windows | `LoreNote_*_x64.msi` | MSI package |

### 📝 Full Changelog

See all changes: https://github.com/loreapp-io-dev/LoreNote/compare/v0.x.x...v0.x.x

## 💡 Tips

### First Time Installing?
1. Download the appropriate installer for your platform
2. Follow the installation instructions
3. Check our [documentation](https://github.com/loreapp-io-dev/LoreNote#for-developers)

### Upgrading from Previous Version?
- Your data is safe! All vaults and notes are preserved
- Simply install the new version over the old one

### Having Issues?
- Check [known issues](https://github.com/loreapp-io-dev/LoreNote/issues)
- Report bugs on [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/loreapp-io-dev/LoreNote/issues/new)

---

**Note**: This is a beta release. Please report any issues you encounter!
